description: This file defines the Address class representing a customer's address in a web-based e-commerce application. It includes fields such as first name, last name, address details, contact info, and billing address indicators, along with getters and setters.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Entity class modeling a customer's address with validation annotations.

methods.name: setStateProvince
methods.description: Sets the state or province of the address.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Sets the country code of the address.

methods.name: getCompany
methods.description: Returns the company name associated with the address.

methods.name: setCompany
methods.description: Sets the company name associated with the address.

methods.name: isBillingAddress
methods.description: Checks if this address is a billing address.

methods.name: setBillingAddress
methods.description: Sets whether this is a billing address.
